strings.meta.title: pdff — Hlanganisa, guqulela njalo ulungise ama-PDF, Word, Excel mahhala
strings.meta.description: Ithuluzi lamahhala ku-intanethi lokuhlanganisa, ukuguqulela, ukunciphisa, ukwahlukanisa kanye nokuvikela ama-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint namafayili ezithombe zakho. Akukho kubhalisa, amafayili asuswa kwangcono.
strings.meta.keywords: hlanganisa pdf, guqulela pdf, pdf ukuya ku-word, word ukuya ku-pdf, jpg ukuya ku-pdf, pdf ukuya ku-jpg, nciphisa pdf, yahlukanisa pdf, excel ukuya ku-pdf, amathuluzi wamahhala we-pdf
strings.footer.text: Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa. Amafayili akho asuswa ngokushesha nje lapho ukucubungula kuqediwe.
strings.home.title: Wonke amaphepha akho, ethuluzini linye.
strings.home.subtitle: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, izithombe: hlanganisa, guqulela njalo ulungise ngemizuzwana.
strings.home.trust: Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa, akukho uphawu olungeziweyo.
strings.home.orbitHint: Bamba uphawu, jikeleza indandatho, thinta iphepha eliphakathi.
strings.home.formatsSubtitle: Lawo ahamba phakathi kwamahhovisi, izikole namabhizinisi.
strings.home.steps[0].title: Phonsa
strings.home.steps[0].text: Donsela amafayili akho ngaphakathi kumbe uwakhethe efonini yakho.
strings.home.steps[1].title: Khetha
strings.home.steps[1].text: Misa ukulandelana, ifomethi yokuphuma kumbe amakhasi ozowagcina.
strings.home.steps[2].title: Dawuniloda
strings.home.steps[2].text: Umphumela uyazidawuniloda wona wodwa, sewulungele ukuthunyelwa.
strings.notice.officeMissingTitle: Amafomethi we-Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint avaliwe.
strings.notice.officeMissingText: Faka i-LibreOffice (mahhala) ukuze uwavule, bese uqalisa kabusha i-pdff. Ku-Windows:
strings.workspace.dropAny: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, izithombe, EPUB, umbhalo…
strings.workspace.approximate: Kusuka ku-PDF, ukwakheka kuyabuyiselwa: umphumela ungadinga ukulungiswa, ikakhulu kumaphepha athwebuliweyo.
strings.workspace.targetEmpty: Engeza ifayili ukuze ubone amafomethi akhona.
strings.workspace.targetNone: La mafayili awanawo ifomethi yokuphuma efanayo.
strings.workspace.limits: Kufika emakhasini angu-{pages} kanye amafayili angu-{files} kumsebenzi ngamunye.
strings.language.title: Khetha ulimi
strings.language.unavailable: Ukuhunyushwa okuzenzakalelayo akukanikwa amandla kulesi siphakeli okwamanje: i-pdff iboniswa ngesiNgisi.
strings.language.failed: Ukuhunyushwa ku-{lang} kwehlulekile. Sicela uzame futhi kamuva.
strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% mahhala
strings.seo.why[0].text: Akukho zibhaliso, akukho khadi lezikweletu, akukho uphawu olungeziweyo kumaphepha akho.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Akukho kubhalisa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Akukho akhawunti okumele uyidalise: vula ikhasi, phonsa amafayili akho, kuphelile.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Amafayili akho ahlala angawakho
strings.seo.why[2].text: Ayacubungulwa, bese asuswa ngokushesha. Asigcini amaphepha akho noma imininingwane yakho.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Wonke amafomethi
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, izithombe, EPUB… kusuka kukhompyutha noma efonini.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Yebo. Wonke amathuluzi mahhala, ngaphandle kophawu futhi akukho okukhiyelwe ngaphansi kokubhalisa. Akukho khadi lezikweletu elicelwayo.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Cha. Akukho kubhalisa, akukho kheli le-imeyili: usebenzisa amathuluzi ngokushesha.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Cha. Amafayili akho asethenziselwa kuphela umsebenzi owucelileyo, bese asuswa. Akekho owafundayo njalo awabelwa muntu.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Yebo. I-pdff isebenza esipheqululini sayiphi indlela yefoni, ithebhulethi noma ikhompyutha (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), ngaphandle kokufaka lutho.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, izithombe (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML nokunye.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ungacubungula amafayili afika kwangu-{files} ngesikhathi esisodwa, futhi iphepha elenziwe lingaba lamakhasi afika kwangu-{pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
strings.privacy.description: Indlela i-pdff ephatha ngayo amafayili akho: akukho akhawunti, akukho phepha eligcinwayo, akukho zikhangiso futhi akukho kuthengiswa kwemininingwane.
strings.privacy.intro: I-pdff yakhelwe ukuthi amaphepha akho ahlale angawakho. Nanka, ngamazwi acacileyo, okwenzekayo uma uyisebenzisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Amafayili akho
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Athunyelwa ngokuvikelekileyo (HTTPS), acubungulwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese asuswa ngokushesha lapho umphumela usulungele. Amafayili amakhulu adlula kwindawo yokugcina yesikhashana ngaphansi kwegama elingahleliwe futhi asuswa ngokushesha lapho ukucubungula kuphela; ukuhlanzwa okuzenzakalelayo kususa konke okungase kusale phakathi kwamahora angu-24 okungenani.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Akukho akhawunti, akukho mininingwane yomuntu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: I-pdff ayiceli ukubhalisa, ikheli le-imeyili noma ikhadi lezikweletu. Amaphepha akho awafundwa, ahlaziywa, abelwa noma asetshenziselwa ukuqeqesha ubuchopho bokuzenzela.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ukulinganiswa kwezivakashi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Sibala ukuvakasha ngaphandle kokwaziwa nangaphandle kwamakhukhini (Vercel Web Analytics) ukuze sifunde ukuthi yimaphi amathuluzi awusizo. Akukho zikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela okuvela kwezinye izingosi.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Amakhukhini
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Ikhukhini elilodwa, elizikhethelayo: likhumbula ulimi olukhethileyo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ukusingathwa
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Isiza singathwa yi-Vercel eziphaketheni e-Paris; ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint kuphathwa yi-Render e-Frankfurt. Laba abahlinzeki baphethe amafayili isikhathi sokuguqula kuphela.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Xhumana nathi
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Umbuzo noma umbono? Xhumana nathi ekhasini lephrojekthi:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Hlanganisa
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Hlanganisa amafayili amaningi (PDF, Word, izithombe…) abe yi-PDF eyodwa, ngokulandelana okukhethileyo.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Hlanganisa amafayili e-PDF ku-intanethi mahhala (Word, izithombe, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Hlanganisa ama-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye namafayili ezithombe abe yi-PDF eyodwa, ngokulandelana okufunayo. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa, akukho uphawu, amafayili asuswa kwangcono.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Faka wonke amaphepha akho efayilini linye: i-pdff yamukela ama-PDF kodwa njalo amaphepha e-Word, amakhasi e-Excel, izethulo nezithombe, ikuhlanganise abe yi-PDF ehlambulukileyo enophawu lwekheli ngalinye lefayili.
strings.tools.fusionner.options.bookmarks.label: Engeza uphawu lwekheli lunye ngalinye lefayili
strings.tools.convertir.name: Guqulela
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Guqulela noma yiliphi iphepha noma isithombe kwesinye isimo.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Guqulela PDF ku-Word, Word ku-PDF, JPG ku-PDF — mahhala
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Isiguquli samahhala: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB namafomethi angaphezu kwangu-40. Ku-intanethi, akukho kubhalisa, izinga eliphezulu.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Isiguquli sinye sawo wonke amafomethi: Word ku-PDF, PDF ku-Word, JPG ku-PDF, PDF ku-JPG, Excel ku-PDF, PowerPoint ku-PDF, PNG ku-JPG, EPUB ku-PDF… Phonsa amafayili akho futhi i-pdff inikeza kuphela amafomethi angenzeka.

strings.tools.diviser.name: Yahlukanisa
strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Yahlukanisa i-PDF ibe ngamafayili amaningi: ngobubanzi bamakhasi noma ikhasi ngezikhathi.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Yahlukanisa i-PDF ku-intanethi mahhala — hlukanisa amakhasi
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Yahlukanisa i-PDF ibe ngamafayili amaningi: ngobubanzi bamakhasi, ikhasi ngezikhathi noma wonke amakhasi angu-N. Mahhala, kuyashesha njalo akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Thumela ingxenye eyodwa kuphela yephepha elikhulu ebalulekileyo: i-pdff inquma i-PDF yakho ngokobubanzi obukhethileyo ibuyisele izingxenye ngefayili ye-ZIP.

strings.tools.diviser.options.ranges.label: Ububanzi
strings.tools.diviser.options.every.label: Amakhasi ngefayili ngalinye
strings.tools.extraire.name: Khipha / susa amakhasi
strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Gcina noma susa amakhasi athile e-PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Khipha noma susa amakhasi ku-PDF — mahhala
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Gcina amakhasi owadingayo kuphela ku-PDF, noma susa lawo angeziweyo. Ku-intanethi, mahhala, akukho kubhalisa, akukho uphawu.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Ikhasi elingenalutho, isithasiselo esingenamsebenzi, eliphindwe kabili? Thayipha amakhasi ozowagcina noma owasuse (ngokwesibonelo 1-3, 7, 10-end) uthole i-PDF ehlambulukileyo ngemizuzwana.
strings.tools.extraire.options.mode.label: Isenzo
strings.tools.extraire.options.pages.label: Amakhasi
strings.tools.organiser.name: Hlela kabusha amakhasi
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Hlela kabusha amakhasi e-PDF ku-intanethi — mahhala
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Shintsha ukulandelana kwamakhasi e-PDF, phinda amanye noma guqula lonke iphepha. Mahhala, ku-intanethi, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Amakhasi athwebuliwe kodwa akulandelana okungafanele? Thayipha ukulandelana okusha (ngokwesibonelo 3, 1, 2, 4-end) noma guqula lonke iphepha: i-pdff iyenzela konke okunye.

strings.tools.organiser.options.reverse.label: Guqula lonke iphepha (akunanze ukulandelana okungenhla)
strings.tools.pivoter.name: Jika
strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Jika wonke amakhasi e-PDF noma amanye kuphela, ngo-90°, 180° noma 270°. Mahhala, kuyashesha, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Ukuthwebula okuphenyene phansi noma ikhasi elibheke eceleni? Jika lonke iphepha noma amakhasi owakhethileyo, ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yizinga.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Engeza izinombolo zamakhasi ku-PDF: khetha indawo, ifomethi ethi "1 / 10", inombolo yokuqala kanye nobukhulu. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Ilungele umsebenzi omkhulu, iphepha lesicelo noma umbiko: khetha indawo, ifomethi kanye nenombolo yokuqala, bese i-pdff ibeka izinombolo zamakhasi akho kahle.

strings.tools.compresser.name: Nciphisa
strings.tools.compresser.seoTitle: Nciphisa i-PDF ku-intanethi — yehlisa ubukhulu befayili mahhala
strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Nciphisa i-PDF ukuze uyithumele nge-imeyili noma uyilayishele kusiza esisemthethweni. Amazinga amathathu wokunciphisa, mahhala.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Isiza senqaba ifayili lakho ngoba liyasindisa kakhulu? Nciphisa i-PDF yakho ngesikhathi ugcina umbhalo ucacile: khetha okungenakulahleka, okunconyiweyo noma okuqinileyo kuye ngobukhulu obudingayo.

strings.tools.proteger.seoDescription: Faka ikhodi ku-PDF ngephasiwedi (AES-256) uvimbele ukuprinta, ukukopa noma ukuhlela. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.proteger.intro: Ngaphambi kokuthumela isitatimende somholo noma iphepha lezempilo, khiya ngephasiwedi eqinile: ngaphandle kwalo, akekho ongayivula.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.tagline: Susa iphepha ku-PDF owazi iphasiwedi yalo.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.seoDescription: Susa iphasiwedi ku-PDF owazi iphasiwedi yayo, ukuze uyivule, uyiprinte noma uyihlanganise ngokukhululekileyo. Mahhala.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Uyazi iphasiwedi, kodwa ukuyithayipha njalo kuyinkinga? Yisuse kanye kuphela. I-pdff ayize yehlise iphasiwedi ongayaziyo.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.options.password.hel: Shiya kungenalutho uma i-PDF inamaphasiwedi wemvume kuphela.
